checks: Later-delivery decisions use one authorized allowance; quarantined deliveries hide further receiving until inspection resolves the original task
Authorized measurement correction reverses original stock, resolves the same issue/task and restores receiving without reopening the obsolete claim
An entirely missing zero-stock receipt can also be corrected through the same controlled history without inventing a stock movement
A correction cannot remove consumed stock; failed correction preserves the hold, issue, receipt and task
A partial agreement preserves a disputed remainder under the same task and hold, then resolves both portions without duplicate compensation
Injected task failure rolls back receiving, stock, cases, holds and issue creation atomically
Concurrent conflicting submissions create one receipt, one investigation and one task
Final credit posting and task completion commit together; injected projection failure never reports an uncommitted or partial outcome
